text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, levofloxacin is not on FDA's shortage list. Corvale East holds 553 units at 32.2 per day (17 days on hand). Corvale General holds 602 units at 30.9 per day (19 days on hand). Stock detail: East 500 mg 315 units (18.4 days), 750 mg 238 units (15.7 days); General 394.1 units (25.3 days) and 207.68 units (13.6 days).

Why (FDA record): One registered plant on our labels, ASCLEMED USA INC. DBA ENOVACHEM (FEI 3001452204), received an OAI classification on 2018-09-27 per FDA inspection 1067059. FDA issued a Warning Letter to the same plant on 2019-06-11. The other registered plant, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited -FTO III (FEI 3002949099), has only VAI inspections, most recently on 2023-10-27.

Our position: Current inventory covers 13 to 25 days across sites and strengths. No FDA shortage listing exists. The historical OAI and Warning Letter at one labeled plant warrant monitoring but do not currently disrupt supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (ranked option 1) — approved by Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer qualifies Cardinal Health 107, LLC (ranked option 2) as secondary source — approved by Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer requests plant information from A-S Medication Solutions and both Advanced Rx entities (ranked options 3–5) — approved by Pharmacy Director.
4. Buyer reports weekly days-on-hand to P&T Committee — approved by Committee Chair.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes; no emergency purchases; no allocation limits at this time.
